english: It is good, Gentle Voice—it is good. You have made this request out of thoughts of compassion which are too great even to imagine. You have made your request for the sake of all those beings who face a wide range of different karmic obstacles; you have made it for both gods and humans, to help them, and bring them happiness. And so—it is good. Tena hi Manjushrih shirnu sadhu cha sushthu cha
